components.css: .ds-resources{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.25rem 1.75rem}.ds-resources a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-block-size:2.75rem;color:oklch(79% .14 175);font:500 .9375rem ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;text-underline-offset:.3em}.ds-resources a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid currentColor;outline-offset:.35rem}.ds-resources a:active{color:color-mix(in oklch,oklch(79% .14 175) 72%,oklch(97% .005 265))}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-resources a:hover{color:oklch(97% .005 265)}}
